{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA test orders
filtered_df = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rate_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute the difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rate_by_channel['email'] - conversion_rate_by_channel['paid_search']

# Print the results
print(f"Conversion rate by channel: {conversion_rate_by_channel.to_dict()}")
print(f"Difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {difference}")"}
